[[The Wilds (outpost)|The Wilds]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]].

== Getting There ==
* From [[Druid's Overlook]] follow the road North. The at the second fork go North again. This road will lead to The Wilds [[portal]].
* The quest [[A Brother's Fury]] will bring you to here.

==Mission==
*[[The Wilds]]
**This mission is the tenth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the first mission in the [[Maguuma Jungle]] region.
